questions.question: Claude wants to run `ls`. Which tool is that?
questions.explanation: Any shell command goes through Bash. ls, python, git: all Bash, all subject to the Bash permission.

questions.question: You put `Bash(rm:*)` under `deny`. What happens when Claude tries to delete a file?
questions.explanation: deny wins over everything. It is the right place for the things you never want, even by mistake.

questions.question: Answers get vague in a long session. Best first move?
questions.explanation: /compact summarises the context and keeps the thread. /clear wipes it: use it when you change topic.

questions.question: `claude -p "..."` is useful because...
options: It runs one prompt with no session, so scripts and schedules can call it
questions.explanation: Headless mode is how automation uses Claude. It still reads CLAUDE.md and respects permissions.
